summary: @nebula.js/cli-build 7.1.2 preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall as "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (per-call scope objects, hex-prefixed identifiers, string dictionaries) and, when bun is not already present on the host, downloads the Bun runtime zip from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<V>/<arch>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, marks the binary executable, and then execFileSync's the freshly-downloaded bun against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (header "// @bun @bun-cjs") using rotated-string-array obfuscation (WV8StW rotator, hex identifiers) that is not readable to Node-focused static analysis. The declared purpose of the package is a Babel/Rollup build helper for the Qlik nebula.js ecosystem, whose stated dependencies are @babel/* and rollup/*; neither the Bun runtime nor an opaque bundled payload is required for that purpose. The behavior fires automatically on npm install via the preinstall lifecycle hook, and executes attacker-supplied bundled code under a runtime that Node-focused scanners do not inspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
